eps.t: Farewell, Unova! Setting Sail for New Adventures!
eps.ov: As our heroes prepare to enjoy the next chapter of their exciting adventures, others have different plans!
As our heroes begin exploring the Decolore Islands, their first stop starts off as a not-so-sweet experience!

eps.t: Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!
eps.ov: As our heroes continue their Decolore Island-hopping cruise, a shipboard theft calls for some super-Connoisseur sleuthing!
Arriving on Scalchop Island, our heroes decide to participate in an unusual competition!
A deserted island gives our heroes the opportunity to witness what enduring friendship is all about!
Arriving on Torom Island, our heroes meet up with an old friend on an important research mission!
As our heroes continue their cruise through the Decolore Islands, a surprise visit by a quartet of unusual pirates changes everyone's course!
As our heroes continue their tour of the Decolore Islands by ship, one island in particular offers them a chance to change a life for the better-forever!

eps.t: The Path That Leads to Goodbye!
eps.ov: Exploring Capacia Island on their way to the Kanto region, little do our heroes know that the path they're on leads to a place they never imagined!
Visiting a seemingly lifeless part of Capacia Island, our heroes come upon a life-giving solution to its dilemma!
A bright light in the night sky gives our heroes a strange change of pace...and face!
As our heroes continue their tour of the Decolore Islands, they encounter a windfall of delicious berries and unexpected new friends!
Arriving on a deserted island on a quest for treasure, our heroes find something much more precious than they anticipated!

eps.t: A Pokémon of a Different Color!
eps.ov: When Ash runs into an old friend en route to the Kanto region, Iris discovers a true kindred spirit!
As our heroes continue their tour of the Decolore Islands, an upcoming celestial event sets the stage for celestial intrigue and delight!
Visiting a Pokémon Center while touring the Decolore Islands, a surprise detour challenges our heroes to help some new friends in need!
A playful island moment turns into a big misunderstanding, and our heroes are about to face a major challenge!
Cilan's brothers arrive for a surprise visit, bringing with them the challenge of a lifetime!

eps.t: Best Wishes! Until We Meet Again!
eps.ov: As our heroes near Vermilion City and the end of their shipboard adventures, one familiar challenge forces them to spring into action!
A visit to Pallet Town to see family and friends shows just how enduring Ash's dreams really are!
